FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 246
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Sponsor: Senator Bobby Singleton
Economic Development
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 04/28/2023
Senate Bill 246 as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of the Secretary of
State to establish a procedure for members of the boards of registrars to track and report hours
worked, as required by the provisions of this bill.
